meta.name: bids
meta.description: Use this skill when working with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理神经影像数据为BIDS标准格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理MRI/EEG等神经影像数据并需要符合BIDS标准。
copy.tagline_en: Organize neuroimaging data into BIDS standard format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with MRI/EEG neuroimaging data and need BIDS compliance.

howto.what: Claude 能帮你整理神经科学数据（MRI、脑电图等）为 BIDS 标准格式，查询数据集中的文件，验证数据是否符合规范，以及将 DICOM 格式转换为 BIDS。
howto.when: 当你需要处理脑成像数据结构（BIDS）数据集时，例如组织数据、查询布局、验证合规性或转换 DICOM 文件。

say.text: 帮我把这个 DICOM 文件夹转换成 BIDS 格式。
验证一下我的 BIDS 数据集是否符合规范。
帮我查询这个 BIDS 数据集中所有被试的 T1w 文件。
say.note: Claude 会使用 PyBIDS 查询并返回文件列表。

howto.what_en: Claude can help you organize neuroscience data (MRI, EEG, etc.) into BIDS standard format, query files in a BIDS dataset, validate compliance, and convert DICOM to BIDS.
howto.when_en: When you need to work with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets, such as organizing data, querying layouts, validating compliance, or converting DICOM files.

say_en.text: Convert this DICOM folder to BIDS format.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through using HeuDiConv or similar tools.

say_en.text: Validate my BIDS dataset for compliance.
say_en.note: Claude will run bids-validator and report issues.

say_en.text: Query all T1w files for subjects in this BIDS dataset.
say_en.note: Claude will use PyBIDS to query and return file paths.
